---
title: "Claude Code + gpt-oss"
---

([Back to the choices](setup.qmd).)

gpt-oss needs 16 GB of memory and about 20 GB of free disk space. You don't need a Claude account.

**Install Ollama, gpt-oss, and Claude Code.** Paste the block into PowerShell (Windows) or Terminal (Mac). The model download takes a while.

**On Windows**:

```powershell
irm https://ollama.com/install.ps1 | iex
ollama pull gpt-oss:20b
irm https://claude.ai/install.ps1 | iex
```

**On Mac**:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh
ollama pull gpt-oss:20b
curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash
```

**Set the context length.** Click the Ollama icon (in the menu bar on a Mac, or the system tray on Windows) > *Settings*, and move the *Context length* slider to *64k*.

**Check.** Open a new terminal window and run

```sh
ollama launch claude --model gpt-oss:20b --yes -- -p "Reply with only the word hello."
```

It should print `hello`. (It can take a minute or two.) Then go to [A First Example](first-example.qmd).
